# Fix: sdkwork-commerce-bootstrap-service renamed to sdkwork-commerce-bootstrap-manifest

## Root Cause
The `sdkwork-commerce` repo renamed `crates/sdkwork-commerce-bootstrap-service` to `crates/sdkwork-commerce-bootstrap-manifest`. The workspace dependency in `sdkwork-clawrouter` still points to the old path, causing `os error 3` (path not found).

## Fix (1 file, 1 line)
**File:** `E:\sdkwork-space\sdkwork-clawrouter\Cargo.toml` line 145

Change:
```toml
sdkwork_commerce_bootstrap = { package = "sdkwork-commerce-bootstrap-service", path = "../sdkwork-commerce/crates/sdkwork-commerce-bootstrap-service" }
```
To:
```toml
sdkwork_commerce_bootstrap = { package = "sdkwork-commerce-bootstrap-manifest", path = "../sdkwork-commerce/crates/sdkwork-commerce-bootstrap-manifest" }
```

No Rust code changes needed — all three imported symbols (`commerce_experience_seed_manifest`, `commerce_recharge_package_seeds`, `commerce_recharge_settings_seeds`) are exported by the new crate at the same names.

## Verification
```powershell
cargo check -p sdkwork-clawrouter-router-service-test-support
```
